name: designer
description: Designer workbench for code-first design/UX decision & quality assurance across Claude Code & Codex CLI (ADR-0042). The third L3 persona after engineer and founder: the six universal cognitive verbs (investigate / frame / decide / compose / critique / refine) re-anchored to UX/UI/CTA/flow — pre-code design thinking (user flows, wireframe specs, CTA copy, information architecture) plus a post-code quality-critique loop that evaluates rendered screenshots + frontend code under usability / accessibility / conversion / consistency lenses. Composes the image L2 capability for generated imagery rather than re-implementing it; Figma and external design tools are excluded in v1 (code-first scope). Incubating scaffold — the persona surfaces (machinery, the six verb skills, the start lifecycle macro, and the meta skills) land across the ADR-0042 implementation ladder; this release ships the atomic scaffold only (manifests, catalogs, release wiring, and the staged shape test).
